fixed_count_rule: Each consumer uses a baseline-only warm 1x probe. Choose 2x for <=10e9 ns/op, 1x for <=20e9, otherwise abort before candidate samples. Each constructor uses 100x. Five pairs in fixed order, separate fresh processes. No count adjustment after candidate samples.
scope: Private constructor and unchanged real rods Union / washer Cut; no other candidate, pooling, census or heap phases.
review: All correctness, constructor and cancellation phases plus both consumer gates must pass. Constructor byte increases must be reported. No speedup claim until evidence accepted.
slot: Parent-assigned serial hosted only. No launch authorization.

cancellation.point: Cancel immediately after reading the successful initial context Err, before constructor; measure until EnforceHeldEmbedding returns at the next poll. This conservatively includes complete constructor and 256 query steps.
